name: Inox India Ltd
tagline: Debt-free cryogenic-engineering leader (ROCE ~33%, ~60% domestic share) with a real >Rs 1,000 Cr US private-space order and defense/MRI optionality - but a ~Rs 19,000 Cr mid-cap at ~74x P/E whose PAT growth has decelerated to flat in Q1 FY27
business_overview: Inox India (formerly Inox CVA) manufactures cryogenic storage/transport equipment across Industrial Gas (~54% of FY26 revenue), LNG (~28%) and Cryo-Scientific (~14%) divisions, with a dominant (~60%+) share of the Indian cryogenic-tank market and applications spanning industrial gases, LNG trucking, green hydrogen, space/aerospace (AS9100D certified) and medical/healthcare. Near debt-free, ~75% promoter-held, ~22% dividend payout. Shareholding lineage is separate from the listed Inox Green/Wind/Leisure entities - no shared capital.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 19,055 Cr (price ~Rs 2,099; P/E ~74, EV/EBITDA ~50, P/B ~17x, book value ~Rs 123)

Revenue Rs 371-382 Cr (+8-9% YoY, a MISS vs 18-20% guide); EBITDA ~flat YoY (+1.4%, margin ~22-23.5%); PAT Rs 58-61 Cr (~flat YoY). Rs 32-35 Cr dispatches slipped on a freight-rate spike / ship availability (deferred, not lost)
Record order book Rs 1,686 Cr at 30-Jun-2026; Q1 inflow Rs 532 Cr (Industrial Gas orders +116% YoY); exports 58% of Q1 sales. Borrowings ~Rs 81 Cr - essentially debt-free
fundamentals_narrative: The return profile is genuinely best-in-class - ROCE ~33%, ROE ~29% (3yr), near-zero debt, ~22% payout, remarkably stable ~22-24% EBITDA margins through cycles, and a ~60%+ domestic cryogenic-tank share that is a real moat. The genuinely new element is a large, specific order in a new end-market: a leading US private-space customer, cumulative >Rs 1,000 Cr to execute over FY27-FY28, with AS9100D aerospace certification in hand and management guiding an even bigger follow-on. The deep read, though, tempers the growth narrative. FY26 PAT grew only ~14% against revenue up ~21.5%, and Q1 FY27 was a clear miss - revenue up just ~8-9% (vs an 18-20% guide and an internal Rs 410-415 Cr target), EBITDA flat, PAT flat - even allowing for the Rs 32-35 Cr of freight-delayed dispatches. So PAT growth has decelerated from ~15% (FY25) to ~14% (FY26) to ~0% (Q1 FY27) while the stock has re-rated to ~74x trailing / ~50x EV/EBITDA. The record Rs 1,686 Cr order book (IG inflow +116%) and the space order point to reacceleration in H2 FY27 and FY28, but the near-term multiple already prices an aerospace-led acceleration that the latest quarter did not show. At ~Rs 19,000 Cr this is a genuine mid/large-cap where a 10x-in-2-3-years is not realistic size math.
technical_read: Not independently pulled this pass. Stock in the Rs 951-1,555 52-week range at last file update; now ~Rs 2,099 after a strong 1-year re-rate.
sentiment_summary: Read the full thread (30 posts, 2024-02 to 2026-08, single batch). Early sentiment (2024) centered on the cryogenic moat and competitive risk from Linde (a major customer that has also started its own India tank manufacturing) and CIMC-Enric. Sentiment stayed constructive through 2025 on LNG-truck adoption, an MRI-machine-component angle (import substitution against a >Rs 2,000 Cr/year import bill), and submarine Air-Independent-Propulsion tank work for the Indian Navy. The most recent and most material development: a trusted user flagged an Rs 871 Cr mega-order from the space-exploration industry in the Industrial Gas segment (Jul 2026) - comparable in size to that entire segment's full-year FY26 revenue (Rs 874 Cr), and consistent with the >Rs 1,000 Cr cumulative aerospace commitment disclosed in the Q1 FY27 concall.
community_signal: Trusted user Chandragupta (24 loves) highlighted the company's work on strategically sensitive defense technology (a Liquid Oxygen tank for India's submarine AIP programme) as evidence of a genuine, hard-to-replicate technical moat. Trusted user Midhunjoe (invested, disclosed) flagged the Rs 871 Cr space-industry order directly from the exchange filing, and separately noted management guided an even bigger follow-on order from the Q4 concall. Trusted user kdjolly gave a detailed company history/moat writeup.

Highlighted the company's strategically sensitive submarine Air-Independent-Propulsion Liquid Oxygen tank work for India's Navy as evidence of a genuine technical moat with 'almost no competition in India and very little elsewhere in the world.'

verdict_headline: A genuine best-in-class cryogenic compounder with a real, large new aerospace order - but at ~Rs 19,000 Cr / ~74x P/E with PAT growth decelerated to flat in Q1 FY27, the 10x-in-2-3-years frame no longer fits; reclassified to 'neither' at Medium conviction
verdict_reasoning: Fundamentals are genuinely excellent (ROCE ~33%, ROE ~29%, debt-free, stable margins, ~60% share) and the >Rs 1,000 Cr US private-space order is a specific, verifiable, commercial-stage catalyst - not vague optimism

thesis_fit moved 10x-in-2-3-years -> neither: at ~Rs 19,000 Cr this is a genuine mid/large-cap where size math is a legitimate 'neither', and the growth case weakened - FY26 PAT +14% on revenue +21.5%, then flat revenue/EBITDA/PAT in Q1 FY27 even adjusting for Rs 32-35 Cr of logistics slippage
